00057 void NullUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int /*blockID*/, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00058 { 
00059  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00060  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00061  memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));

00064 NullUGenInternal* NullUGenInternal::getInstance() throw()
00065 {
00066  static NullUGenInternal* instance = new NullUGenInternal(); 
00067  static bool firstTime = true;
00068  
00069  if(firstTime)
00070  {
00071   firstTime = false;
00072  }
00073  else
00074  {
00075   instance->incrementRefCount();
00076  }
00077  
00078  return instance;

00093 #if !defined(UGEN_VFP) && !defined(UGEN_NEON) && !defined(UGEN_VDSP)
00094 void ScalarUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int /*blockID*/, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00095 {  
00096  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00097  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00098  LOCAL_DECLARE(float, value_);
00099  
00100  // this is faster on the Mac with compiler optimisations on the Mac sice it
00101  // gets replaced by vectorised operations!
00102  memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00103  for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)
00104   outputSamples[i] += value_;
00105 }
